outer_catalogs.name: rk_plugin_library
outer_catalogs.original_definition_exact: quant #outer [[contract]] rk_plugin_library, "every library named by plugin.library.paths, including code it invokes, registers rk_conf callbacks only through public setters and only when each callback meets that member's candidate contract; it registers interceptors only through the public setters, with success result zero and each exact list/union-arm candidate in outer-candidates:5c3f8c4723832c0e9e6ebb784be6a57ebc0264d519421d5b95a18a8f68c18147; every registered interceptor and all code it invokes meets that inventory's neutral custody restriction (all pointer arguments borrowed, no release, retention, ownership transfer or global custody effects, scalar resource handles borrowed too, and every local acquisition balanced before return); registered callback code and opaque contexts remain valid through the last possible invocation, including destruction and copied on_new registrations; configuration interceptors are installed on a live configuration and client interceptors only from on_new before initialization completes, never on share consumers; it calls cJSON_InitHooks nowhere and does not replace cJSON's global allocator hooks; it neither mutates cJSON child, prev or next links directly nor passes malformed cJSON lists to an API call; it never directly stores into librdkafka internal members (including callback fields, op fields, broker and rule-14t links, queues and list links); it invokes no non-public librdkafka symbol and calls public APIs only under their published conditions; any allocator hooks installed before this library loads satisfy cjson_allocator_hooks";

observations: rd_kafka_plugin_new duplicate path returns0 without a fresh conf_init; new path requires rd_dl_open, conf_init resolution and conf_init0 before list insertion.
rddl uses RTLD_NOW|RTLD_LOCAL under WITH_LIBDL, alternative LoadLibrary/GetProcAddress on Windows; extension fallback is real.
rd_kafka_plugin_destroy closes handle after caller-promised conf_destroy; loader refcount and actual order remain explicit environment obligations.
flb_plugin_load uses RTLD_LAZY and copies typed descriptor bytes; dlsym success alone establishes neither descriptor ABI nor callback effects.
flb_plugin_proxy_create ignores flb_plugin_proxy_register return and returns allocated proxy; proxy allocation or load success does not establish successful registration.
Go proxy resolves FLBPluginInit as required, optional flush/exit alternatives separately; instance/API/context are handed to loaded code.
Interceptor registration success, exact list/union arm, live conf/on_new-before-initialized and nonshare restrictions are independently needed; samples do not establish whole-world closure.
